title: Does anybody use AI asisted daily stock analysis tool?
author: _dread_89
selftext:
Hello Monkeys,

Recently I came accross a chinese(english asistance also) github repo which automize stock analysis by AI asistance. I set up the configurations and I am notified over telegram. I wonder that any of you use this tool? I want to be sure the analysises are accurate. Since I am software guy I am not competent to validate outputs. Maybe we can validate results together with finance experts.

Here is the repo, please look at

https://github.com/ZhuLinsen/daily\\\_stock\\\_analysis

comments.author: Devvirat
comments.body: Looks really interesting! AI-generated analysis sounds useful, but I’d be curious to see how accurate the signals are over a longer period. Would be great if someone with a finance background could validate the results. Definitely worth experimenting with. ([github.com](https://github.com/ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis))
